proof: Put the original diagonal endpoints atO=(0,0),V=(12,6). Reflection inOV has matrix[[3/5,4/5],[4/5,-3/5]]. The folded image of(12,0) isR=(36/5,48/5).
The cut leaves triangleOPV, whereP=OR intersect y=6=(9/2,6). Reflect P inOV to Pprime=(15/2,0). The unfolded quadrilateralO,P,V,Pprime is the rhombus.
OP=sqrt((9/2)^2+6^2)=15/2. The other3 sides have the same length15/2. Original6,12, reflected endpoints and existing cuts fix this uniquely; it is not a measurement of the sketch.
